stance: Conditional watch: delivery progress is constructive; valuation and parent funding remain unqualified.
question: Can delivered rent grow faster than financing claims and share dilution over the next 30–90 days?
takeaway: PF2 has moved from a promise to a first 25 MW RFS hall. The trade now depends on additional delivery, rent conversion and funding terms. A new $2.5B Series G commitment expands financing options, not shareholder value by itself.
valuation_note: Use project-level cash flows after construction spending, debt service and preferred distributions, then parent residual value divided by a reconciled diluted share count. No price target: current quote, refreshed capitalization, ownership waterfalls and remaining build costs are not fully verified.

cases.name: Bull
cases.thesis: Further RFS converts to recurring rent while project financing limits parent equity funding.
cases.requires: Evidence of at least the next 25 MW toward the original 300 MW North Dakota target, rent commencement and favorable funded project terms.
cases.invalidated_by: Delivery slippage, weak rent conversion or financing that transfers too much residual value to lenders/preferred investors.

cases.name: Base
cases.thesis: Capacity ramps in stages but near-term common-equity returns remain sensitive to funding terms and dilution.
cases.requires: Ongoing delivery without assuming all commissioned MW earns rent; distinguish fit-out revenue from recurring base rent.
cases.invalidated_by: Either demonstrated recurring cash/distribution inflection or a material delivery/funding shortfall.

cases.name: Bear
cases.thesis: Construction cash needs and preferred issuance outrun recurring rent, reducing per-share upside despite a larger lease book.
cases.requires: Missed milestones, adverse project financing, significant new issuance or weak cash conversion to emerge.
cases.invalidated_by: On-schedule tenant service, improving rent collections and fully evidenced funding with manageable parent contributions.

checkpoints.label: North Dakota 300 MW target
checkpoints.watch: Next PF2 hall and tenant service/rent evidence; current disclosed statuses total 275 MW.
checkpoints.positive: Additional RFS and rent commencement corroborate target progress.
checkpoints.negative: Confirmed failure to deliver by the deadline, an explicit schedule revision or customer acceptance problem. No public update alone means unconfirmed, not failed.

checkpoints.label: ChronoScale note conversion or maturity
checkpoints.watch: $97M parent-funded note: approval effectiveness and conversion versus repayment/extension.
checkpoints.positive: Clear conversion terms and reconciled post-deal ownership.
checkpoints.negative: Unclear settlement or additional parent support beyond the disclosed note.

checkpoints.label: Recurring economics and share bridge
checkpoints.watch: Base rent, fit-out, collections, unrestricted parent cash, capex and Series G common conversion.
checkpoints.positive: Recurring rent/cash improves with transparent funding and dilution reconciliation.
checkpoints.negative: Headline growth driven by fit-out while funding pressure rises.

checkpoints.label: Delta Forge 1 / Polaris Forge 3 finance
checkpoints.watch: Closing evidence, amount funded, project recourse and parent equity requirement.
checkpoints.negative: Target slips or high residual claims/parent contributions.

gaps: No verified current executable quote or same-date fully diluted share count; no entry/stop or price target is asserted.
Parent-accessible liquidity and remaining construction spend are not reconstructed.
Macquarie preferred waterfall/redemption economics and ChronoScale fully diluted economics need a full entity-level bridge (85.6% reported beneficial ownership assumes note conversion).
